in_hebrew.name: עזלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Isleen is believed to originate from the Hebrew language, meaning 'God is my help'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl, expressing the idea that God is always by her side, providing strength and support.

in_greek.name: Ισλεην
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, the name Isleen is interpreted as 'God's will'. It reflects the belief that God has a plan for each person and that following His will leads to a fulfilling and purposeful life.

in_latin.name: Isleana
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of Isleen is 'Isleana'. It means 'God's shining one', emphasizing the idea of divine grace and favor bestowed upon the bearer of this name.
